issues.reason: Names and casing makes the name-derived symbol plus exactly one Name fact mandatory for every proper noun and states that the Compound concepts rules do not apply to one, so fusing 'Marshall' into the class symbol marshall_basketball_coach and emitting no (Name marshall "Marshall") violates a stated rule.

The clause is future ('will be introduced ... today'), and Status predicates says the surface tense wraps every categorical atom the clause yields ('Bob will be a doctor' -> (Future (Member bob doctor))), so the flat untensed atom asserts a present role the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: 'be introduced AS <NP>' — an as-predicative naming a role on a passive verb: nothing says whether it yields a categorical atom, how it is tensed, or whether it links to the event

a proper noun used as a MODIFIER inside a common-noun compound ('Marshall basketball coach'): proper nouns are excluded from compound fusion and no head is licensed to link the named institution to the role kind

Ordinal's scale slot for a succession rank among officeholders ('the 25th ... coach') — the scale is defined as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension, and a rank in a series of postholders is neither
new_gaps: the repair's residue is itself a gap: a proper noun appearing only as a compound modifier ends up carrying its mandatory Name atom with no licensed relation to anything else in the parse, since coining a head to attach it is barred
repair_summary: Replaced marshall_basketball_coach with basketball_coach in all three atoms that used it (typing, genus, Ordinal), removing the proper noun from the class symbol; added the mandatory (Name marshall "Marshall") atom, left unlinked because no licensed head connects the institution to the role; wrapped the role typing in (Future ...) to match the clause's surface tense.
notes: The Ordinal atom is left untensed as the confirmed issue names only the flat categorical atom, and Ordinal is not one of the categorical heads the tense-wrapping rule enumerates. (Location sk_press_conference_1 big_green_room) stands: a press conference is an event-noun eventuality, so Location is the ordinary event-side oblique rather than the entity-attached head 'Where a THING is' governs.
